The main takeaway from our work is that
SR can be done in a non-parametric way, i.e., without assuming anything about the blur kernel (or the underlying natural image).
the correct PSF to use for SR is not the camera PSF, but rather the blur kernel that is induced on the image by the recurrence property of natural images.
